pillars.headline: ISO 20022, end to end.
pillars.lede: pain.001, pacs.008, camt.053 and acmt.001. Libraries, MCP servers and language servers. Adopt one at a time.

repos.name: pain001

repos.name: pacs008
repos.text: Generate, validate, parse and audit pacs.008 FI-to-FI credit transfers with scheme-aware rules.

repos.name: bankstatementparser
repos.text: Parse CAMT, MT940, OFX, CSV and PDF bank statements into one unified transaction model.

repos.name: iso20022-mcp
repos.text: One MCP gateway to search, validate, generate and parse ISO 20022 across pain, pacs, camt and acmt.

pillars.headline: Post-quantum, ready to pilot.

repos.name: kyberlib

repos.name: crypto-service
repos.text: 50+ classical and post-quantum algorithms, including ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA.

repos.name: hsh
repos.text: Multi-algorithm password hashing with a typed policy, PHC storage and auto-rehash on drift.

repos.name: passmcp
repos.text: Test any MCP server and learn, in plain language, whether it is ready for your agents.

repos.name: noyalib

repos.name: rlg

repos.name: dotfiles
repos.text: A cross-platform workstation control plane on chezmoi, with adaptive themes and AI CLI workflows.
